originalTitle: U.S. stock futures flat with Fed rate decision, megacap tech earnings on tap
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures moved little on Tuesday evening as investors hunkered down before the conclusion of a Federal Reserve meeting and several megacap technology earnings due later in the day.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures moved little on Tuesday evening as investors hunkered down before the conclusion of a Federal Reserve meeting and several megacap technology earnings due later in the day.

Nasdaq futures advanced slightly after memory chip giant SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) posted bumper third-quarter earnings, with tech remaining upbeat after Anthropic's filing for an initial public offering helped restore confidence in the artificial intelligence trade.

Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.1% to 29,839.75 points by 20:00 ET (00:00 GMT). S&P 500 Futures were flat at 7,759.25 points, while Dow Jones Futures steadied at 52,586.0 points.

Futures steadied after gains in tech spurred a strong Tuesday session on Wall Street.

Fed set to keep rates steady; hawkish outlook in focus

The Fed is widely expected to leave interest rates unchanged at 4.0% at the conclusion of a two-day meeting on Wednesday. The central bank had hiked rates by 25 basis points in September.

But despite bets on a hold, markets remained cautious over the Fed's outlook on rates, especially in the face of increasingly sticky inflation.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh had largely reiterated the bank's commitment to reaching its 2% annual inflation target, likely entailing more monetary tightening if price pressures remain high.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Warsh's address after the Fed decision will be closely watched for more commentary.

Beyond the Fed meeting, third-quarter gross domestic product data and September PCE price index data are due on Thursday, and are also expected to factor into expectations for interest rates.

The PCE data is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, with core PCE seen remaining well above the central bank's 2% target.

Megacap tech earnings on tap; SK Hynix firms on blowout Q3

Focus on Wednesday will be squarely on September quarter prints from Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) and Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL), which are expected to offer more insights on AI-related spending in the coming months.

The two are among the biggest spenders on AI in Wall Street, but have faced mounting shareholder scrutiny over whether their investments in the technology are yielding adequate returns.

Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN)– another major AI spender– is also set to report earnings on Thursday.

Memory chip giant SK Hynix, which is a key supplier to the AI industry, rose 4% in aftermarket trade after it clocked a blowout third quarter and said it planned to return a total 100 trillion won ($75.5 billion) to shareholders in 2026. Rival Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) added 3%.

Beyond tech, GE Vernova LLC (NYSE:GEV), KLA Corporation (NASDAQ:KLAC), T-Mobile US Inc (NASDAQ:TMUS), and Automatic Data Processing Inc (NASDAQ:ADP) are also set to report on Wednesday

chineseTitle: 美国股指期货与美联储利率决定持平，大型科技股盈利即将公布

chineseContent:
Investing.com——周二晚间，美国股指期货几乎没有变动，因为投资者在美联储会议结束以及当天晚些时候发布的几家大型科技公司财报之前都保持观望。

存储芯片巨头 SK 海力士（纳斯达克股票代码：SKHY）公布第三季度财报后，纳斯达克期货小幅上涨，在 Anthropic 申请首次公开募股帮助恢复人们对人工智能行业的信心后，科技股仍然乐观。

截至东部时间 20:00（格林威治标准时间 00:00），纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.1% 至 29,839.75 点。标准普尔 500 指数期货持平于 7,759.25 点，道琼斯期货则稳定于 52,586.0 点。

在科技股上涨带动华尔街周二走强后，期货企稳。

美联储将维持利率稳定；鹰派前景成为焦点

市场普遍预计美联储将在周三为期两天的会议结束时将利率维持在 4.0% 不变。央行9月份加息25个基点。

但尽管押注维持不变，市场对美联储的利率前景仍持谨慎态度，尤其是在通胀日益粘性的情况下。

美联储主席凯文·沃什(Kevin Warsh)在很大程度上重申了该行实现2%年度通胀目标的承诺，如果物价压力仍然很高，可能需要进一步收紧货币政策。

不确定在盈利之前买什么？在业绩下滑后，我们的 AI 最近的财报前电话会议带来了 +77% 至 +118% 的涨幅。查看本月收益精选 »

沃什在美联储决定后的讲话将受到密切关注，以寻求更多评论。

除美联储会议外，第三季度国内生产总值数据和 9 月 PCE 物价指数数据将于周四公布，预计也将影响利率预期。

PCE数据是美联储首选的通胀指标，核心PCE仍远高于央行2%的目标。

大型科技股即将盈利； SK海力士第三季度业绩井喷

周三的焦点将集中在微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）和 Alphabet 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）的 9 月份季度报告上，预计这些报告将在未来几个月提供有关人工智能相关支出的更多见解。

这两个人是华尔街人工智能领域最大的投资者之一，但他们在技术上的投资是否能产生足够的回报，面临着越来越多的股东审查。

另一家主要人工智能支出公司亚马逊公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）也将于周四公布财报。

存储芯片巨头 SK Hynix 是人工智能行业的主要供应商，第三季度业绩井喷，并表示计划在 2026 年向股东返还总计 100 万亿韩元（755 亿美元），其售后市场交易上涨 4%。竞争对手美光科技 (NASDAQ:MU) 上涨 3%。

除了科技之外，GE Vernova LLC（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GEV）、KLA Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：KLAC）、T-Mobile US Inc（纳斯达克股票代码：TMUS）和自动数据处理公司（纳斯达克股票代码：ADP）也将于周三发布报告
